title: compare_versions orders 1.10 before 1.9
body: `compare_versions` in `pkgtools/versions.py` compares the dotted parts as strings, so `compare_versions("1.10.0", "1.9.0")` returns -1. Parts must be compared as numbers. A missing trailing part counts as zero, so `"1.2"` and `"1.2.0"` are equal.
